Bottini Fuel

Bottini's own site posts no per-gallon price. The Mid-Hudson Fuel Buyers Community publishes the terms it negotiated with Bottini for its members. Source, read 2026-11-19.

Pricing model

For 2026-27 the Mid-Hudson Fuel Buyers Community published, for members who enrolled between 7 July and 7 August 2026: a fixed price of $4.399/gal, paid in advance; a cap of $4.399/gal with a non-refundable enrollment cost of $0.35/gal; and a variable price set at the New Hamburg terminal price plus $0.65/gal. Contracts run to 30 June 2027.

Price per gallon online?
Mid-Hudson members, 2026-27: $4.399/gal fixed or cap (cap adds $0.35/gal enrollment). Enrollment closed 7 Aug 2026.

What its own pages say

The group page says Bottini moved its payment terms from Net 21 to Net 10. Fixed and cap members estimate their gallons (at least 300). Non-members buy from Bottini direct; its own site lists automatic delivery and a Price Protection page but no price.

How this listing was built

Read from the Mid-Hudson Fuel Buyers Community's 2026-27 oil prices page and Bottini Fuel's own homepage. Nothing on this page is estimated: where the dealer does not publish a figure, none is given. Ask for a quote at midhudsonfuelbuyers.org/prices-oil and compare it with your state's EIA average.
